name: pharmacy-bonus-functions
description: Cloud Functions backend for the 10% Discount Pharmacy bonus offer app

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore,auth
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-pharmacy --only firestore --config ../firebase.json "node --test test/offers.integration.test.mjs"
scripts.test:callables: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-pharmacy --only auth,firestore,functions --config ../firebase.json "node --test test/callables.test.mjs"
scripts.test:triggers: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-pharmacy --only firestore,functions --config ../firebase.json "node --test test/triggers.test.mjs"
